Sure! Here’s a comprehensive summary of the **2014 Dow Corning Tennis Classic**:

---

## Overview

**The 2014 Dow Corning Tennis Classic** was a professional women’s tennis tournament played on indoor hard courts. It was the 20th edition of the tournament, which is part of the **ITF Women’s Circuit**. The event took place in **Midland, Michigan, United States**, between **10 and 16 February 2014**.

---

## Tournament Details

- **Category:** ITF Women's Circuit
- **Date:** February 10–16, 2014
- **Edition:** 20th
- **Location:** Midland Community Tennis Center, Midland, Michigan, USA
- **Surface:** Indoor Hard
- **Prize Money:** $100,000

---

## Entrants

### Singles Main Draw Entrants

#### Seeds

Seeds were based on rankings as of February 3, 2014.  
(The top seeds generally included high-ranking ITF/WTA players, but the exact seed list isn’t specified in the original sources.)

#### Other Entrants

- **Wildcards:**
  - Tornado Alicia Black
  - Brooke Austin
  - Taylor Townsend
  - Alexandra Stevenson

- **Qualifiers:**
  - Françoise Abanda
  - Lena Litvak
  - Alexandra Mueller
  - Naomi Broady

- **Lucky Loser:**
  - Victoria Duval

---

## Champions

### Singles Champion

**Heather Watson (UK)**  
- **Defeated:** Ksenia Pervak (Russia)  
- **Score:** 6–4, 6–0

**Notes:**  
Heather Watson’s win at Midland was a big step in her comeback, following illness in 2013.

---

### Doubles Champions

**Anna Tatishvili (Georgia) / Marina Melnikova (Russia)**  
- **Defeated:** Sharon Fichman (Canada) / Maria Sanchez (USA)  
- **Score:** 6–2, 7–5

---

## Notable Players & Facts

- **Taylor Townsend:** Was a promising American junior, given a wildcard.
- **Alexandra Stevenson:** Former Wimbledon semifinalist, also received a wildcard.
- **Victoria Duval:** Entered the main draw as a lucky loser.
- **Tournament Significance:** It is one of the most prestigious $100,000 ITF Women's Circuit events in the U.S., often serving as a springboard for players moving up to the WTA Tour.

---

## Historical Context

- **About the Tournament**: Held annually in Midland since 1989 (originally as a $25k event), the Dow Corning Tennis Classic has helped launch the careers of many future WTA stars.
- **Sponsor:** Long-time sponsorship by Dow Corning Corporation.
- **Legacy:** Now known as the Midland 100K/Women's Tennis Classic in later years.

---

## Additional Resources

- [ITF Tournament page (archived)](https://www.itftennis.com/en/tournament/$100000-midland-mi/usa/2014/w-witf-usa-03a-2014/)
- [Official Tournament Website (Archived)](https://web.archive.org/web/20131213150155/http://www.dowcorningtennisclassic.com/)
